attempts.raw_response: {"category":"coding-development","confidence":0.86,"evidence":[{"fact":"该工具接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（需开启），所有更改以全有或全无方式应用。","paragraph_id":"p4s2"},{"fact":"补丁会先针对当前文件内容整体校验（上下文定位、工作区包含、符号链接策略、重复路径），任一失败即中止且不写入任何字节。","paragraph_id":"p24s1"},{"fact":"删除与移动操作通过 ctx.shell 执行，其沙箱强度取决于已加载的 shell 执行器，与原生 bash 工具风险姿态相同。","paragraph_id":"p29s1"},{"fact":"新增文件不会创建父目录，与原生 write 工具一致，错误信息会指出缺失的目录。","paragraph_id":"p29s11"},{"fact":"不支持模糊或偏移匹配，hunk 位置按精确匹配后 trimEnd 再 trim 处理，模糊匹配仅在路线图上。","paragraph_id":"p29s13"}],"id":"gh:1367967226","insufficient_evidence":false,"limitations":["删除/移动依赖外部 shell 执行器与沙箱配置，bash-local 下无沙箱围栏","新增文件不会自动创建父目录，需目录已存在","不支持二进制补丁，遇到即报错","仅精确 hunk 匹配，模糊匹配尚未实现","作者称兼容各 DSH 版本线，本次未实际验证"],"summary_zh":"为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单一 apply_patch 补丁工具：默认支持 git/unified diff，可选开启 Codex apply_patch 语法，补丁整体校验后全有或全无应用；删除/移动依赖 ctx.shell 的沙箱强度，新增文件不会创建父目录，hunk 定位为精确匹配，作者称兼容 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.5-rc.2 等 DSH 版本。","tags":["apply_patch","补丁编辑","DeepSeek Harness","git diff","Codex语法"]}

{"metadata":{"description":"Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool for git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), all-or-nothing application, 0.1.2-rc.1 ~ 0.1.5-rc.2 compatible.","id":"gh:1367967226","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-patch-edit-plus","slug":"drscrewdriver/dsh-patch-edit-plus","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool for git/unified diff (default) a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nd Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), all-or-nothing application, 0.1.2-rc.1 ~ 0.1.5-rc.2 compatible"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"d Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), all-or-nothing application, 0.1.2-rc.1 ~ 0.1.5-rc.2 compatible."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-patch-edit-plus"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Français | Deutsch | Italiano | Русский | Español"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one model-facing `apply_patch` tool that accept"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s **git/unified diff** (default) and **Codex `apply_patch` syntax** (opt-in), applies every change *"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"*all-or-nothing**, and stays completely out of DSH's way."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## DSH version compatibility"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| DSH version | Status | Notes |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| `0.2.0-rc.1+` | ✅ supported (this line, v0.3.0+) | Declarative settings: `allowCodexPatch` is mark"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ed `.volatile()` — the settings form renders automatically and `loader/volatile-update` re-registers"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" the tool without a remount. No registration call. Delete/Move migrated to the `ShellExecutor.execut"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"e()` + `result()` foreground API. |
| `0.1.7-rc.1+` | ↗ maintenance line | Served by the `compat/0.1"},{"id":"p7s5","text":".7` branch / `dsh-0.1.7` dist-tag (v0.2.1 there). 0.2.0's shell executor renamed `run` → `execute` ("},{"id":"p7s6","text":"introduced between 0.1.2 and 0.1.7), so one codebase cannot serve both lines type-safely. |
| `0.1.2"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"-rc.1` ~ `0.1.5-rc.2` | ↗ maintenance line | Served by the pre-0.1.7 branch / `dsh-0.1.5` dist-tag. "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"0.1.7 removed the imperative settings APIs the dual-API fallback relied on. |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Settings are declarative on this line: fields marked `.volatile()` in `Config` become the settings f"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"orm; the plugin subscribes to `loader/volatile-update` instead of receiving registration hooks."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why patch at all? (tool routing guide)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The tool description explicitly routes the model:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Single small change in one already-read file** → prefer the native `edit` tool (a patch costs mo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"re tokens than a literal edit).
- **Small change inside a LARGE file** → `apply_patch` (no need to e"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"cho the whole file).
- **Batched changes across MANY files** → `apply_patch` (one call, verified ato"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"mically).
- **New file with substantial content / delete / rename** → `apply_patch`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Unified diff (default, enabled)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Enable with `allowCodexPatch: true`. When a Codex patch arrives while disabled, the tool returns an "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"**actionable hint** (how to enable or how to retry in unified diff) instead of a generic parse error"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" — Codex syntax is a strong prior for GPT-family models and a silent failure traps them in retry loo"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"Codex syntax is a strong prior for GPT-family models and a silent failure traps them in retry loops."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Operations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Operation | Unified diff | Codex | Execution path |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Add | `new file mode` + `/dev/null` | `*** Add File:` | `ctx.fs.writeText` (official intent dance)"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" |
| Update (multi-hunk) | `@@` hunks | `@@` hunks | `ctx.fs.writeText` |
| Delete | `deleted file m"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ode` + `/dev/null` | `*** Delete File:` | `ctx.shell` (sandbox-aware, env-passed path) |
| Move / re"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"name | `rename from/to` | `*** Move to:` | `ctx.shell` |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Guarantees"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **All-or-nothing**: the whole patch is verified against current file content first (context locati"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"on, workspace containment, symlink policy, duplicate paths); any failure aborts with zero bytes writ"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ten.
- **Read-before-write gate respected**: every write replicates the official `write` tool's inte"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nt dance — `fs/write-intent` waterfall → guarded `writeText` → `fs/observed` emit. A bare `writeText"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"` would silently bypass the gate because DSH providers never dispatch `fs/*` events themselves.
- **"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"Precise failure diagnostics**: on hunk mismatch the error carries file + hunk index, search origin l"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ine, expected-line preview (whitespace made visible), the file's actual excerpt, and a targeted hint"},{"id":"p24s8","text":".
- **Newline fidelity**: CRLF files are written back as CRLF; no-trailing-newline tails are preserv"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ed unless the patch changes the tail.
- **Pure addition**: the plugin registers exactly one tool, ne"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"ver calls `tools.restrict()`, never overrides a native tool, registers no global services, and remov"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"es everything on unload. Name conflicts with other `apply_patch` providers (`bainianlaoyao/dsh-codex"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"-mode`, `shuind/dsh-codex-harness`, …) are resolved by rename avoidance (`apply_patch_1`, `…_2`, …) "},{"id":"p24s13","text":"so DSH never fails to start."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Option | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `toolName` | `apply_patch` | Model-facing tool name. |
| `conflictPolicy` | `rename` | `rename` / "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"`skip` / `fail` when the tool name is taken. |
| `renameSuffix` | `_1` | Suffix used by rename avoid"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ance. |
| `allowUnifiedDiff` | `true` | Accept git/unified diffs. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Limitations (disclosed)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Delete/Move run through `ctx.shell`.** The sandbox strength is whatever the loaded shell executo"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"r enforces (`bash-sandbox` fences; `bash-local` does not) — the same risk posture as the native bash"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" tool. Every request carries a `sandboxPolicy` and reports sandbox facts so "policy denied" is disti"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"nguishable from "command failed".
- **Every write and every Delete/Move carries the session-scoped p"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"olicy.** `apply_patch` resolves `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session })` per call — the session's mo"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"de override plus its cwd as the workspace root — exactly like the native `write`/`edit` tools, and r"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"esolves plan paths against that same root. Without it the enforcing filesystem falls back to the dep"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"loyment root, which makes in-workspace writes fail as `workspace-write` denials even in a `danger-fu"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"ll-access` session. A `workspace-write` denial surfaces as a `PatchError` whose message carries the "},{"id":"p29s10","text":"backend text (the structured `[sandbox: …]` marker and the same-turn escalation fields are not imple"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"mented; use the native `write`/`edit` tools when you need to escalate).
- **Add does not create pare"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"nt directories.** This matches the native `write` tool (`ctx.fs` has no mkdir); the error names the "},{"id":"p29s13","text":"missing directory.
- No fuzzy/offset matching: hunk location is exact → `trimEnd` → `trim`, delibera"},{"id":"p29s14","text":"tely (fuzzy matching is unsafe for destructive ops; it is on the roadmap).
- Binary patches are reje"},{"id":"p29s15","text":"cted with a clear error."}],"truncated":true}
